# Performance: the rewrite against C

Release builds, measured 2026-11-08T14:00:19Z to 2026-11-08T18:16:01Z on a 10-CPU arm64 MacBookPro18,4 (Apple M1 Max, macOS 27.0.1, Darwin 27.0.0), the legs' samples interleaved; load average 2.80 before and 5.86 after. The rewrite at `28895b50da10`. Figures are medians; compare only builds measured on this machine, in one run of this script.

```
c: curl 8.23.1-DEV (Darwin) libcurl/8.23.1-DEV OpenSSL/3.6.3 zlib/1.2.12 brotli/1.2.1 zstd/1.5.7 c-ares/1.34.9 libidn2/2.3.8 libpsl/0.23.3 libssh2/1.11.1 nghttp2/1.71.0 ngtcp2/1.25.0 nghttp3/1.19.0 mit-krb5/1.7-prerelease OpenLDAP/2.4.28/Apple

```

Both legs link one HTTP/3 build: ngtcp2 of no recorded build from `/Users/kov/work/deps`, the C legs its shared libraries and the Rust legs its static archives; nghttp3 1.19.0 (`None`).

## tests/perf (9 runs each, reference configuration)

## scorecard

A run the scorecard reports errors for is left out of its cell's median and counted as failed in it. A requests run fails when a response is not a 200 or the tool exits with an error; with `--parallel`, Rust's tool exits with a transfer's failure where C's can forget it (DIVERGENCE.md), so a run in which both legs lost transfers can fail on the Rust leg alone.
